messages:
Maya: Quick follow-up from the disk-pressure postmortem. I pulled a short hotlist of follow-ups so we can close looped items quickly — want quick acks and owners so we can slot them into the next sprint.

Ravi: Ack. Can you paste the items here? I can pick up anything infra-adjacent.

Maya: TL;DR list: 
1) Tune tiered-eviction settings to reduce noisy GC (owner: Ravi, ticket: RWD-4127, due: 2024-07-12). R: Ravi, A: Maya, C: Omar, I: Ben.
2) Add eviction/kb_pressure metrics + alert (owner: Omar, ticket: RWD-4128, due: 2024-07-19). R: Omar, A: Lena, C: Ravi, I: Support.
3) Nightly pruning job to clear temp payloads (owner: Ravi, subtask of RWD-4127, due: 2024-07-15).
4) Run replay on the two recurring traces and add regression guard to CI (owner: Lena, ticket: RWD-4130, due: 2024-07-22). R: Lena, A: Maya, C: Eng, I: Support.
5) Postmortem doc -> add runbook checklist + oncall playbook (owner: Ben, ticket: RWD-4131, due: 2024-07-10).

Omar: For (2) I need a short schema for the metrics. Suggest `eviction_count`, `eviction_rate`, `cache_kb_pressure`. Also will need a brief window to deploy; will schedule a 30m infra window if OK.

Ravi: Taking (1) and (3). I estimate ~6-8h for config testing + canary. I'll create the subtask in RWD-4127 and link PRs.

Ben: I'll own the runbook write-up. Need an example log snippet I can paste. Maya, can you drop one or two extracted traces?

Maya: Pasted a trace excerpt below for runbook (sanitized):
``
[2024-06-28T03:14:22Z] node-13: cache_kb_pressure=92% eviction_count=7 reason=partial_gc
[2024-06-28T03:14:23Z] node-21: OOM avoided via eviction, lat_p95 spikes -> 320ms
``

Lena: On the regression guard: propose a small perf-eval target (max p95 increase +1.5x) and gating at PR. I'll draft the test harness.

Maya: Thanks. Two coordination notes: (a) can everyone add their Jira ticket link in the postmortem doc so we have cross-links; (b) weekly 15-min sync Tuesdays 09:30 PT for the next 4 weeks to track progress unless someone objects.

Ravi: +1 to Tuesday sync. I'll add `RWD-4127` PR link once ready. :thumbsup: 

Omar: Scheduling infra window Thursday 10:00-10:30 PT for metric rollout. Assigning `RWD-4128` to myself.

Ben: I'll start the runbook skeleton and @Maya will paste traces into the doc.

IncidentBot: Followup checklist created and linked: RWD-4127, RWD-4128, RWD-4130, RWD-4131.

Maya: Cool — quick ownership summary for handoff: Ravi -> config & pruning (RWD-4127), Omar -> metrics & deploy (RWD-4128), Lena -> regression guard (RWD-4130), Ben -> runbook (RWD-4131). I'll act as escalation A for all. If anything slips >2 business days past due, ping me directly and I'll escalate.

Lena: Adding the RACI block to the postmortem doc now.

Ravi: Will create subtasks and estimate effort. ETA for PR links: EOD Thurs.

Maya: Thanks team. Please update the postmortem doc and your ticket fields (due, acceptance criteria). We'll review at the Tuesday sync.

Ben: Noted.

Omar: Done: added metric schema + scheduled window.

Maya: Closing thread — looks like we have owners and dates. If anyone needs to rearrange, update tickets and notify here. :white_check_mark:
